description: This file declares functions related to generating and broadcasting watchdog events within a service management system. It includes function prototypes for starting and stopping the event producer, as well as broadcasting specific watchdog events to interested listeners.

methods.name: startWatchdogEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog event producer, setting up any necessary resources or threads.

methods.name: stopWatchdogEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the watchdog event producer and releases associated resources.

methods.name: broadcastWatchdogEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a watchdog event to listeners, indicating the event code, value, and associated service or group name.
